# NX-OS DNS Integration Test
#
# Tests DNS server and domain configuration.
#
# Expected gNMI paths:
#   dns-items - DNS configuration with servers and domain

-- dns/config --
apiVersion: networking.metal.ironcore.dev/v1alpha1
kind: DNS
metadata:
  name: config
  namespace: default
  labels:
    networking.metal.ironcore.dev/device: device
spec:
  deviceRef:
    name: device
  adminState: Up
  domain: example.com
  servers:
    - address: 10.10.10.10
      vrfName: management

-- state --
{
  "System": {
    "dns-items": {
      "adminSt": "enabled",
      "prof-items": {
        "Prof-list": [
          {
            "name": "default",
            "dom-items": {
              "name": "example.com"
            },
            "vrf-items": {
              "Vrf-list": [
                {
                  "name": "management",
                  "prov-items": {
                    "Provider-list": [
                      {
                        "addr": "10.10.10.10"
                      }
                    ]
                  }
                }
              ]
            }
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  }
}
